info.title: Slimlytics API
info.description:
Account, personal API token, site configuration, privacy-preserving collection, reporting, goals, export, and real-time APIs for Slimlytics.

Use a short-lived session JWT for creating personal API tokens. Use a `slyt_…` personal API token for durable CLI and agent access. Both use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Collection write keys authorize ingestion only.

AccountForbidden.description: Not allowed for this credential (API tokens, non-admins), or error code `mfa_required` when a session that verified a passkey within 12 hours is needed

currentPassword.description: Required to add the first passkey. Adding more needs a session that verified a passkey within the last 12 hours.

options.description: WebAuthn `publicKey` creation or request options (binary fields are base64url)

refreshToken.description: Opaque `slrt_` refresh token. Single use: every refresh returns a new one. Sessions stay signed in for 30 idle days (365 days at most).

mfaVerified.description: This session verified a passkey within the last 12 hours

mode.description: favicon fetches the site's icon now and fails with 400 if none can be loaded

writeKey.description: Collection-only key; not an account credential

serverWriteKey.description: Rotatable collection-only secret for trusted server request batches. Included only for site owners and admins (API tokens also need sites:write); otherwise use serverWriteKeyHint, or POST /api/sites/{siteId}/keys as an owner or admin

proxyKey.description: Server-side secret sent by the site's first-party proxy as X-Slimlytics-Proxy-Key with X-Slimlytics-Client-IP so locations and visitor IDs use the real visitor IP. Included only for site owners and admins (API tokens also need sites:write). Keep it out of public repositories; rotate with POST /api/sites/{siteId}/rotate-proxy-key if exposed

serverWriteKeyHint.description: Last four characters of serverWriteKey, prefixed with an ellipsis. Returned by the site read endpoints

proxyKeyHint.description: Last four characters of proxyKey, prefixed with an ellipsis. Returned by the site read endpoints

canManageKeys.description: Returned by the site read endpoints: whether serverWriteKey and proxyKey are included (owner or admin, and for API tokens the sites:write scope)
